summary: Fixed 14 technology issues in combat.ts to match design specifications

fixes_applied.specification: Deals 20% of target's current HP as damage
fixes_applied.implementation: Used weapon.percentDamage property (already existed), verified handling in shipActs()

fixes_applied.specification: 75% chance to destroy incoming missiles − 1% per missile tech level
fixes_applied.implementation: Added checkZyroShield() function with per-missile rolls, Tech Level reduction

fixes_applied.specification: 100% chance to destroy incoming missiles − 1% per missile tech level
fixes_applied.implementation: Added checkLightningShield() function with per-missile rolls, Tech Level reduction

fixes_applied.specification: 5 damage to all adjacent ships + 1 damage per 2 firing ships
fixes_applied.implementation: Added activatePulsar() function with base 5 damage + scaling bonus

fixes_applied.specification: 10 damage to all adjacent ships + 1 damage per 2 firing ships
fixes_applied.implementation: Handled in same activatePulsar() function with base 10 damage for ionic

fixes_applied.specification: Ship cannot move, fire, or retreat
fixes_applied.implementation: Added applyStasisField() function, inStasisField property checked in shipActs() and attemptRetreat()
Added activateRepulsorBeam() function with hex push calculation
Added handleCloakingOnFire() and refreshCloaks() functions, +5 defense via cloaked check in calcHitChanceVs()

fixes_applied.specification: Point defense destroys 40% of incoming missiles (−1% per missile tech level)
fixes_applied.implementation: Added checkAntiMissileRockets() function with 40% base − tech level penalty
Fixed calcHitChanceVs() to use separate attack/defense multipliers instead of differential
